## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve or the value it would add.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like this feature to work.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🎮 Category
- [ ] Gameplay (weapons, props, mechanics)
- [ ] Networking (WebRTC, signaling, matchmaking)
- [ ] Graphics (particles, shaders, models)
- [ ] Audio (sound effects, music)
- [ ] UI/UX (HUD, controls, menus)
- [ ] Infrastructure (deployment, scaling, monitoring)
- [ ] Documentation

## 📝 Additional Context
Any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request.
